workshoptitle: Build Connected Hospitality Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: The Seer Hotels hospitality intelligence story and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Use a converged query to connect stay offer service needs, reservations, semantic matches, and service coverage.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Application Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas choose between JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON Relational Duality for a guest application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Guest Concern Search
tutorials.description: Review how Gilly built semantic search with an in-database embedding model for stay offers and guest-service notices.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate a Booking Abuse Network
tutorials.description: Review Bob's graph approach to finding reservations linked by shared booking evidence with Oracle Property Graph and SQL/PGQ.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Route Guests to the Closest Hotel Property
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial for hotel property and visitor-region analysis.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Stay Offer Demand Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train and score a stay offer demand-surge model inside Oracle Database.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Hospitality Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use Select AI to turn natural-language hospitality questions into SQL you can inspect and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Hospitality Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a read-only hospitality agent that uses an approved SQL tool.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
